about: A rewrite of the grep search tool in Rust, aiming to work the same as GNU grep.

prs.title: The last matching include or exclude rule now decides
prs.broken: When a search mixed rules for which files to include and which to skip, any skip rule won, whatever the order. GNU grep lets the last rule that matches a file decide, so the two picked different files.
prs.changed: The rules are now kept in the order you typed them, and the last one that matches a file decides, like GNU grep.
prs.matters: Searches over a folder look at the same files as GNU grep.
